item.title: 10 Beginner DevOps Projects You Can Build in 2025 (GitHub Actions, Docker, Terraform & More)

item.title: From Zero to CI/CD: Build Your First GitHub Actions Pipeline for a Simple Node/Python App

item.title: Docker Tutorial for DevOps Beginners (2025): Build a Tiny App and Containerize It from Scratch

item.title: Cloud Fundamentals for DevOps Beginners (2025): From Zero to Your First Free-Tier Server
